ta542_campaigns.campaign_name: COVID-19 Vaccination Self Compliance Report O365 Credential Theft
ta542_campaigns.targeting_evidence: The message were tailored to the target entities by spoofing their specific HR divisions (e.g., HR@[organizationname.tld]).
ta542_campaigns.channels: Corparate email > Fake login / credential-collection page

ta542_campaigns.campaign_name: Ave Maria COVID-19 Preventative Measures campaign
ta542_campaigns.targeting_evidence: The campaign targeted dozens of customers, with more than 90% of the intended targets in the energy vetical. The emails contained email addresses unique to the target entity (e.g., healthcare@[targetcompany].com).

roles.role_victim: Employees in energy and industrial organizations

ta542_campaigns.request: Open an attached Excel file (covid-19_preventative measures.xlsx) which exploits Equation Editor vulnerabilities to install Ave Maria remote access trojan.
ta542_campaigns.pretext: Health advisories containing new COVID-19 preventative measures relating to the target compamy's policies, alongside global infection and vaccination statistics.
